notes.title: BOSS BATTLES?
notes.content:
[b]Oh that's right, post launch support and updates! [/b] 
Thanks to everyone who has supported me and played Tesserarii.  Here are some updates for y'all.

[h3]Boss battle debuffs[/h3]
The biggest change is that bosses now apply a debuff when battled.  There is plenty of warning about what their debuff will be, so make sure you strategise and build accordingly.  

[h3]Environmental Changes[/h3]
It got a bit stale looking at the same board over and over, so we have updated the colour to help you understand how much progress you have made

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
There was some pretty decent softlocks, but thanks to the community we have found and squished them.  

We have also added in a Rule Book which goes in a bit more detail about the rules of the game, allowing you to strategise around how you wish to tackle and progress

notes.title: You already know its a Week 1 update!
notes.content:
and its not all bugs....

but there was definitely a fair few squished! 

Also added:
- New powerups
- Powerups unlock based on progression
- New character individual powers

notes.title: Quick little day 1 patch
notes.content: You know how it goes, something goes wrong, a bit of a balance here and there, visual bugs that are terrible for the first time user experience.  I wanted to clean them up

notes.title: Leaderboards and Achievements
notes.content:
Another little update for Tesserarii, and while I'm continually improving the game behind the scenes, this update includes:

- Leaderboards
- Steam Achievements
and of course
- Bug fixes!

With the release coming soon, this is all I have to share for you folks at the moment! I hope you enjoy Tesserarii!

notes.title: Balance update and Tutorial Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Based on some user feedback, I have made some balance changes to the enemies health at various stages.  I have also made some changes to the tutorial so that it should now present more smoothly.  Nothing major for this update as I am working on making the full release version as smooth as possible, but I felt this would be necessary. 

Thanks!
